strategy_catalog.name: Enlarged Tile Sizes - Minimal
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Increase BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, and BASE_K from 64 to 128. Larger tile sizes amortize loop overhead, improve L0A/L0B utilization from 25% to 50%, and reduce the number of Mmad iterations per tile.

constraints: BLOCK_M must be multiple of C0 (=16 for fp16)
BLOCK_N must be multiple of C0
BASE_K must be multiple of C0

strategy_catalog.name: Enlarged Tile Sizes - DSL
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Increase BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, and BASE_K from 64 to 128. Larger tile sizes amortize loop overhead, improve L0A/L0B utilization from 25% to 50%, and reduce the number of Mmad iterations per tile.

constraints: BLOCK_M must be multiple of C0 (=16 for fp16)
BLOCK_N must be multiple of C0
BASE_K must be multiple of C0

strategy_catalog.dsl: TILE_SIZE { BLOCK_M: 128, BLOCK_N: 128, BASE_K: 128 } CONSTRAINT { L0A_buf: 2*BLOCK_M*BASE_K*2 <= 64KB, L1_Q_buf: BLOCK_M*dim*2 <= (512KB - KV_buf - P_buf), alignment: BLOCK_M % C0 == 0, BLOCK_N % C0 == 0 } IMPACT { bandwidth: 9/10, register: 6/10, compute: 7/10 } EXPECT { speedup: [1.5, 2.5] } FILES { tiling.h, kernel.h }

strategy_catalog.name: Enlarged Tile Sizes - Usage Scenarios
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Increase BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, and BASE_K from 64 to 128. Larger tile sizes amortize loop overhead, improve L0A/L0B utilization from 25% to 50%, and reduce the number of Mmad iterations per tile.

constraints: BLOCK_M must be multiple of C0 (=16 for fp16)
BLOCK_N must be multiple of C0
BASE_K must be multiple of C0

usage_scenarios.benefit: Larger tiles reduce per-tile sync and loop overhead
Can allocate larger Q/KV buffers without overflow

usage_scenarios.reason: May cause L1 overflow, fallback to smaller tiles

hardware_constraints.calculation: For dim=128: Q_buf = 128*128*2 = 32KB, KV_buf = 32KB, P_buf = 64KB, total = 128KB (fits)

strategy_catalog.name: Enlarged Tile Sizes - Anti Patterns
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Increase BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, and BASE_K from 64 to 128. Larger tile sizes amortize loop overhead, improve L0A/L0B utilization from 25% to 50%, and reduce the number of Mmad iterations per tile.

constraints: BLOCK_M must be multiple of C0 (=16 for fp16)
BLOCK_N must be multiple of C0
BASE_K must be multiple of C0

anti_patterns.pattern: Increase tile sizes without checking L1 budget
anti_patterns.reason: For dim=512, Q_buf = 128*512*2 = 128KB, KV_buf = 128KB, P_buf = 64KB, total ~384KB, may overflow L1 512KB limit
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Check dim first: if dim >= 512, keep BLOCK_M=64 or reduce to 96

anti_patterns.reason: L0A/L0B require 512Byte alignment, C0=16 for fp16. Non-multiple causes alignment error
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Always use BLOCK_M % C0 == 0, BLOCK_N % C0 == 0

anti_patterns.reason: VEC2_M_CHUNK mismatch with BLOCK_M causes inefficient row processing
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Set VEC2_M_CHUNK = BLOCK_M or BLOCK_M/2 for optimal vectorization

precautions: Verify L1 buffer budget before changing tile sizes
Ensure all tile size parameters are C0-aligned
Check subBlockNum compatibility: BLOCK_M must be divisible by subBlockNum
Monitor L0A/L0B utilization metrics after tile size change

strategy_catalog.name: WorkspaceQueue Pattern - Minimal
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Replace raw CrossCoreSetFlag/WaitFlag with a typed WorkspaceQueue class that encapsulates workspace ring-buffer management. WorkspaceQueue provides ProducerAcquire() to get the next slot, ProducerReleaseFix() or ProducerReleaseMte3() to signal completion, and ConsumerAcquire() which waits with the correct PIPE_MTE2 mode.

strategy_catalog.name: WorkspaceQueue Pattern - Priorities
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Replace raw CrossCoreSetFlag/WaitFlag with a typed WorkspaceQueue class that encapsulates workspace ring-buffer management. WorkspaceQueue provides ProducerAcquire() to get the next slot, ProducerReleaseFix() or ProducerReleaseMte3() to signal completion, and ConsumerAcquire() which waits with the correct PIPE_MTE2 mode.

implementation_priorities.action: Add WorkspaceQueue class encapsulating workspace ring-buffer management

strategy_catalog.name: WorkspaceQueue Pattern - Principles
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Replace raw CrossCoreSetFlag/WaitFlag with a typed WorkspaceQueue class that encapsulates workspace ring-buffer management. WorkspaceQueue provides ProducerAcquire() to get the next slot, ProducerReleaseFix() or ProducerReleaseMte3() to signal completion, and ConsumerAcquire() which waits with the correct PIPE_MTE2 mode.

principles.description: Use the minimal pipeline scope for each sync: FIX for S/O output (Fixpipe completion), MTE3 for P output (DataCopy completion), MTE2 for AIV consumption
principles.rationale: Eliminates mismatch between producer pipeline (FIX/MTE3) and consumer pipeline (MTE2), preserving overlap for unrelated channels

principles.description: Encapsulate slot offset calculation (head/tail % RING_SLOTS * slotSize) in the queue class, eliminating manual offset tracking errors
principles.rationale: Manual offset calculation is error-prone; encapsulation ensures correct slot indexing across PRELAUNCH tiles

principles.description: Producer side (AIC) uses Acquire/Release; Consumer side (AIV) uses Acquire with wait
principles.rationale: Clear separation of roles prevents sync misuse: producer signals completion, consumer waits for readiness

performance_bottlenecks.description: Original CrossCoreSetFlag/WaitFlag uses PIPE_ALL, draining all pipeline channels
performance_bottlenecks.impact: Destroys pipeline overlap, adding ~20-30 cycles delay per sync

performance_bottlenecks.description: Each tile requires manual wsOffset = slot * BLOCK_M * BLOCK_N calculation
performance_bottlenecks.impact: Scalar computation overhead per tile, ~5-10 cycles

strategy_catalog.name: Vectorized RowMuls/RowDivs - Minimal
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Replace scalar RowMulsImpl/RowDivsImpl loops with vectorized RowMuls/RowDivs helper functions. These functions use Mul/Div with BinaryRepeatParams to achieve row-wise broadcast scaling at vector width (64 fp16/cycle) instead of scalar width (1/cycle).

VEC2_row_ops.RowMuls: RowMuls(oPrevUb_, oPrevUb_, expStateUb, dealRows, dim, actualDim)
VEC2_row_ops.RowDivs: RowDivs(oNewUb, oNewUb, sumStateUb, dealRows, dim, actualDim)

strategy_catalog.name: Vectorized RowMuls/RowDivs - Anti Patterns
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Replace scalar RowMulsImpl/RowDivsImpl loops with vectorized RowMuls/RowDivs helper functions. These functions use Mul/Div with BinaryRepeatParams to achieve row-wise broadcast scaling at vector width (64 fp16/cycle) instead of scalar width (1/cycle).

VEC2_row_ops.RowMuls: RowMuls(oPrevUb_, oPrevUb_, expStateUb, dealRows, dim, actualDim)
VEC2_row_ops.RowDivs: RowDivs(oNewUb, oNewUb, sumStateUb, dealRows, dim, actualDim)

anti_patterns.reason: PIPE_V RAW冒险(Duplicate写buf后Mul立即读同一PIPE_V无PipeBarrier) + padding区域垃圾值不清零 + 累积精度误差

anti_patterns.pattern: LocalTensor[] 下标运算符作为 float 标量参数传入 Muls
anti_patterns.reason: LocalTensor[] 返回子张量视图 LocalTensor<T>，不是标量 T。使用 GetValue(tensor, index) 提取标量值
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Use scale tensor directly: RowMuls(dst, src0, src1_tensor, rows, cols, actualCols)

anti_patterns.pattern: Brcb(dst,src,count) 只传3个参数替代 RowMuls
anti_patterns.reason: AscendC Brcb 需要4个参数: Brcb(dst,src,repeatTimes,dstStride)。正确的行级广播乘法是RowMuls函数
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Use RowMuls(dst, src0, src1, rows, cols, actualCols) with defined helper function

anti_patterns.pattern: 直接调用RowMuls而不先定义该函数
anti_patterns.reason: RowMuls不是AscendC框架内置API，是用户自定义函数。调用前必须定义此函数
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Define or import vector_common_row_ops.h before calling RowMuls

precautions: RowMuls/RowDivs are NOT built-in AscendC APIs - must define them first
Scale tensor must be properly sized: each row's scale at offset row*BRCB_NUM
dealRows parameter is row count, dim is aligned column count, actualDim is actual column count
State tensors (expStateUb, sumStateUb) must be in VECCALC position

strategy_catalog.name: Targeted SetWaitFlag - Minimal
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Replace all PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL> with targeted SetWaitFlag<HardEvent::X_Y> calls. PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL> drains all pipeline channels, destroying overlap. Targeted barriers only wait for the specific dependency needed.

strategy_catalog.name: Targeted SetWaitFlag - Usage Scenarios
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Replace all PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL> with targeted SetWaitFlag<HardEvent::X_Y> calls. PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL> drains all pipeline channels, destroying overlap. Targeted barriers only wait for the specific dependency needed.

usage_scenarios.benefit: Targeted barriers preserve overlap for unrelated channels

conditions: Mix of Cube and Vector operations
usage_scenarios.benefit: Reduces cumulative barrier overhead from N*PIPE_ALL to N*targeted_wait

hardware_constraints.description: Scalar, Vector, Cube, DMA units execute asynchronously in parallel
hardware_constraints.impact: PIPE_ALL barrier drains all units, destroying parallelism

hardware_constraints.value: M_MTE1, MTE1_M, M_FIX, FIX_MTE2, MTE3_MTE2, MTE2_V, V_MTE3, MTE3_V
hardware_constraints.usage: Each HardEvent represents specific dependency between two pipeline stages

strategy_catalog.name: Targeted SetWaitFlag - Anti Patterns
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Replace all PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL> with targeted SetWaitFlag<HardEvent::X_Y> calls. PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL> drains all pipeline channels, destroying overlap. Targeted barriers only wait for the specific dependency needed.

anti_patterns.pattern: Use PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL> for every synchronization point
anti_patterns.reason: Drains all pipeline channels (V, M, MTE1, MTE2, MTE3, FIX), destroying overlap
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Use SetWaitFlag<HardEvent::X_Y> for specific dependency only

anti_patterns.reason: set/wait synchronization mismatch causes state residue, affecting subsequent operators
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Always pair SetFlag and WaitFlag for the same HardEvent

anti_patterns.reason: Counter limit is 15, exceeding causes deadlock without reverse sync
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Use bidirectional sync or reset counter after 15 uses

precautions: Ensure SetFlag and WaitFlag are paired for each HardEvent
Verify pipeline overlap improvement with profiling tools
Test with mssanitizer to detect sync mismatch early

strategy_catalog.name: Multi-level KV Outer Tiling - Minimal
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Implement a two-level KV sequence tiling scheme with s2OuterBlocks and s2BaseSize. When kvSeqLen is large, split it into s2OuterBlocks outer blocks of size s2BaseSize. Q can be loaded once at the start of each outer block and reused across all inner micro-tiles.

s2BaseSize.description: Outer KV block size in rows

strategy_catalog.name: Multi-level KV Outer Tiling - Usage Scenarios
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Implement a two-level KV sequence tiling scheme with s2OuterBlocks and s2BaseSize. When kvSeqLen is large, split it into s2OuterBlocks outer blocks of size s2BaseSize. Q can be loaded once at the start of each outer block and reused across all inner micro-tiles.

s2BaseSize.description: Outer KV block size in rows

conditions: L1 can hold Q chunk of size mBaseSize*dim
usage_scenarios.benefit: Q loaded once per outer block, reused across microNLoops inner tiles, reducing GM->L1 traffic by factor of microNLoops
Can cache larger Q chunk across inner tiles

usage_scenarios.reason: Outer tiling overhead exceeds benefit, keep single-level tiling

hardware_constraints.description: Large kvSeqLen benefits from Q reuse across inner tiles
hardware_constraints.impact: Reduces GM->L1 Q traffic from N_tiles to N_outer_blocks

strategy_catalog.name: Multi-level KV Outer Tiling - Principles
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Implement a two-level KV sequence tiling scheme with s2OuterBlocks and s2BaseSize. When kvSeqLen is large, split it into s2OuterBlocks outer blocks of size s2BaseSize. Q can be loaded once at the start of each outer block and reused across all inner micro-tiles.

s2BaseSize.description: Outer KV block size in rows

principles.description: Load Q once per outer block (bz, qHead, qRowStart) and keep it resident in L1 across all inner micro-tiles
principles.rationale: Each inner tile reuses the same Q data, avoiding redundant GM->L1 loads

principles.description: tileBase += microNLoops per outer block ensures correct Vec1/Vec2 slot indexing across outer blocks
principles.rationale: Slot index depends on total tile count, not just inner loop index

principles.description: Outer loop iterates over s2OuterBlocks, inner loop over microNLoops within each outer block
principles.rationale: Separates Q residency scope (outer) from KV tile processing scope (inner)

performance_bottlenecks.bottleneck: Repeated Q loading per KV tile
performance_bottlenecks.description: Without outer tiling, Q is loaded for each KV tile even when Q is unchanged
performance_bottlenecks.impact: For kvSeqLen=4096, BLOCK_N=128: 32 Q loads instead of s2OuterBlocks Q loads

performance_bottlenecks.description: Q chunk of size mBaseSize*dim must stay resident in L1
performance_bottlenecks.impact: For mBaseSize=256, dim=512: Q buffer = 256KB, may overflow L1
